policies.title: Grenada: North Macedonian ordinary passports
policies.summary: Grenada's current Embassy schedule directly assigns North Macedonian visitors to a visa granted at the port of entry.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary North Macedonian passport for short visitor travel.
The schedule's own legend defines Port of Entry as a visa granted on arrival in Grenada.
The schedule was revised in April 2024 and should be rechecked early if Grenada publishes a replacement.

policies.title: Panama: North Macedonian ordinary passports
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy nationality schedule lists Macedonia in its no-visa-required cohort.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary North Macedonian passport for a tourist visit of up to three months.
This passport-wide rule is distinct from Panama's conditional waiver for holders of qualifying third-country visas or residence documents.
Work, residence, study, transit, diplomatic and final-admission rules remain separate.

policies.title: Ukraine: North Macedonian biometric passports
policies.summary: Ukraine's current treaty register marks the permanent bilateral visa-abolition agreement for valid biometric travel documents in force.
conditions: Applies to a valid biometric North Macedonian ordinary passport for entry, exit, transit and stays up to 90 days in any 180-day period.
Non-biometric, refugee, stateless, residence, work and other special-document routes are outside this policy.
